about: Which of our agents does what in the fringe repository's definitions of where agents run: each agent's altitude (A3) with the A2 loops, A1 LLM calls and A0 compute it runs, its runtime (R1-R5), model endpoints (M1-M4), I/O level (L0-L5), account and key. Every item labelled: fact (read from the agent's own files or ours), evidence (read elsewhere, or inferred from what it does: the reason given). The definitions are the fringe's; the mapping is the librarian's. At Dinis's word, ~22:00 UTC, 11 November (BRIEF.md item 3).

definitions.status: draft v0.2, for Dinis and Angelo to correct

swarms.what: the incident team: incident.conductor@web-summit.dinis and the agents below, at Dinis Cruz's word
swarms.control_plane: incident.conductor@ (starts the sessions, sets each wake)
swarms.label: fact

swarms.crossing: we feed her desks material on her conductor's inbox or in commits addressed For: her agents; we read her public files and never write to them
swarms.label: fact

swarms.crossing: its definitions are read here (this file); nothing of ours is written there
swarms.label: evidence
